## About
World Tech Automotive is a full auto repair shop in Garland, Texas, run by owner Josh Lynch. We do everything from oil changes and brake work to engine, electrical and diesel repair.
We want you to understand what's going on with your car. That means telling you what repairs are needed, what they should cost, and how long they'll take. Customers have given us a 5 star rating across 90 Google reviews, and a lot of them talk about how we explain things.
If you don't see the repair you need on our list, just ask. Give us a call or stop by the shop.

## Services
- Check engine light diagnostics and repair: When the light comes on, we find out why and fix it.
- Brake and ABS repair: Brake repair, including anti-lock braking systems.
- Engine repair: Engine performance checks, engine repair and engine replacement.
- Electrical repair: Electrical diagnostics plus alternators, starters, power windows, power locks and lights.
- Diesel repair: Repair work on diesel vehicles.
- Suspension and steering: Shocks, struts, chassis, suspension and steering repair.
- Routine maintenance: Oil changes, brake inspections and the regular upkeep that keeps your car running.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Will you tell me the cost before you start?
A: Yes. We let you know what repairs are needed, the estimated cost, and how long the work will take.

Q: What if I don't see my repair on your list?
A: Just ask. Give us a call and tell us what's going on with your car.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 213 E. Buckingham Rd, Suite 106, in Garland, TX.
